chain.text: **Estate**: 18 ha; 11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc; clay and flint soils. **Output**: 62,000 bottles average; 48,000 in 2024 after May hail cut a fifth of western plots. **Certification**: Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023; earliest certification 2026. **Export**: 41% of sales, mainly Belgium and Japan; Japanese importer requires sulphites under 60 mg/l. **Failures**: 2022 tank 4 controller drifted 3°C for two days; bulk loss €11,000; now calibrated pre-harvest, second probe fitted. **Failures**: 2023 label error sent 900 wrong-vintage bottles; recalled; proofs need two signatures. **Rules**: No irrigation on western plots; 2021 trial cut acidity below Japanese threshold. **Rules**: Harvest dates set from sugar and acidity over three consecutive mornings, never calendar. **Rules**: Tanks above 28°C during fermentation cooled within four hours. **Pending**: Lighter bottles proposed 2025; importer unconfirmed; no cost comparison done. **Pending**: Eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided; vines 54 years old, yields down 30% in

**Estate**
18 ha: 11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc.
Clay and flint soils.

**Output**
Average 62,000 bottles; 48,000 in 2024.
May hail cut a fifth of western plots.

**Certification**
Organic since 2019.
Biodynamic conversion began 2023; earliest certification 2026.

**Export**
41% of sales; mainly Belgium and Japan.
Japanese importer requires sulphites under 60 mg/l.

**Failures**
2022: tank 4 controller drifted 3°C for two days; €11,000 loss.
Now calibrated pre-harvest, second probe fitted.
2023: 900 wrong-vintage bottles recalled; proofs need two signatures.

**Rules**
No irrigation on western plots; 2021 trial cut acidity below Japanese threshold.
Harvest dates set from sugar and acidity over three mornings, never calendar.
Tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours.

**Pending**
Lighter bottles proposed 2025; importer unconfirmed; no cost comparison.
Eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided; vines 54 years old, yields down 30%.
